summary: Created the Design Brief: 'The Digital Dojo'. This document captures the 'Far East Spiritual Hyper-Realism' aesthetic. It defines the color palette (Jade, Gold, Ink), textures (Porcelain, Silk), and metaphors (Kintsugi for error correction, Sumi-e for data flow). This ensures the visual identity is 'premium' and 'soulful', not just 'tech'.
